drhp.business: Exxaro Tiles offers a comprehensive and reliable range of vitrified tiles across residential, commercial and institutional segments. drhp.expansion: Exxaro's growth strategy centres on improving capacity utilisation, particularly at the Talod facility, while strengthening brand visibility and deepening market penetration across underpenetrated Tier-II and Tier-III markets. The Company continues to expand its channel partner network and build relationships with architects, contractors and institutional buyers. In exports, Exxaro intends to deepen its presence across its current 11-country footprint while selectively evaluating new geographies. Operational efficiency improvement remains an ongoing priority, with a focus on lifting utilisation levels at both plants.
